name: Tiki-Ti Mai Tai Mix
description: Tiki-Ti's house Mai Tai mix, called for directly in Jeff Berry's transcription of the Jim's Special in Sippin' Safari. Berry's approximation is 2 parts curaçao, 1 part orgeat, 1 part simple syrup.
instructions: Combine 2 parts orange curaçao with 1 part orgeat and 1 part simple syrup.
